# obligation-article-19-0

**Article 19 — Automatically generated logs ## 1 Providers of high-risk AI systems**

Article 19 — Automatically generated logs ## 1 Providers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control.
